item.title: RimWorld Crafting Quality Calculator — Masterwork & Legendary Chance
item.description: Use the RimWorld crafting quality calculator to estimate the chance of each item quality (Awful to Legendary) for a given crafting skill. Built for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Crafting Quality Calculator Crafting quality chance estimator Crafting skill (0–20) 10 Inspired creativity QualityChance Approximate baseline for RimWorld 1.6. Actual odds vary by skill passions, inspirations and MODs. Why Quality Matters Higher quality items give better stats — a Masterwork weapon deals more damage and an Excellent armor protects better.
